name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 4 Local Keyword Research
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
How to build a local keyword list by combining services with location modifiers and checking real volume.

# Key concepts
- Focus on buying intent; local intent often includes a city or "near me".
- Google Keyword Planner: enter seed terms, set the target location, read volume and seasonality.
- Localize: "[service] [city]", "[city] [service]", "best [service] [city]", neighborhood names, "near me".
- Competitor keyword "stealing": paste a competitor URL into Keyword Planner's website option, or use Ahrefs, Moz, Semrush.
- Long-tail phrases (3 to 5 words) convert better and are easier to rank.

# Steps
1. Brainstorm seed keywords per service.
2. Pull Keyword Planner ideas with the city as location.
3. Expand with modifiers and autocomplete.
4. Check 1 to 2 top competitors.
5. Finalize 10 to 20 target keywords, grouped by intent.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- TAG rule: validate volume in [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) and Keyword Planner before choosing any blog keyphrase, and use search terms verbatim.
- Transactional local terms belong to service/city pages, blogs take informational terms (avoids cannibalization).
